title: Toddler Moments
description: Things that are almost guaranteed to happen at a 2-year-old's party. Watch the birthday kid, not the card.
items: More interested in the box than the gift
Frosting ends up in someone's hair
Says a new word for the first time today
Wanders off to pet the dog
Needs a diaper change at the worst time
Tries to blow out the candle before the song ends
Throws food off the high chair
Gets a second wind at bedtime
Runs the wrong way during a game
Finds the one breakable object in the room
Gives a random guest a kiss
Insists on holding the balloon string forever
Says 'no' to everything for five minutes straight
Falls down and immediately laughs about it
